name: 06-habit-sync
idea: A mobile habit tracker that works offline and syncs across a user's devices. Users define habits with a target frequency, tick them off each day, and see a streak. Ticking must work with no network and must never be lost when the app is killed. Conflicts are resolved per habit-day, last write wins, and the streak is recomputed from the day records rather than stored. Sign-in is optional at first launch so the app is usable before an account exists.
